edits.new_text:
### 7.3.10 Not run and deviations

The DAS experiment's deviation log records what was not run and what departed from the plan; the four that bear on the claims above are quoted verbatim from `results/deviations.json` (iteration-8 correction: new subsection).

- **D-drop.** "Drop order applied: plan resampling (1) and the T1 extension (2: T1 DAS and the literal top-five placement on T1) were not run; M's top-k placement uses T2's leave-one-survivor bans only."
- **D-tfsets.** "Held-out teacher-forced evaluation scores held-out PROMPT pairs with the training target program sets (no separate held-out target sets)."
- **D-targets.** "Distinct 48-token openings are few (the model repeats openings), so the default pool was extended to TRAIN-family padding-twin samples (commit1_<task>_v2 amendment); validation target sets are filled from training programs where < 8 distinct programs exist; T10 dfs has 3 distinct programs, T03 heapify_pop 1 and full_sort 2 (T03 short-program fallback: >= 16 tokens)."
- **D-cap.** "Generation caps are exp30's 384 (bench) / 512 (T2) tokens, not 1,024/1,536: engine-check comparability with exp30 and the time budget; truncations are counted per cell (results/cells.json, n_length)."

Two further deviations are used above: D-randinit (the committed untrained-network comparison against the diverged fit, replaced post hoc by the matched likelihood fit; Section 7.3.5) and D-C-k (forced sources were generated at ranks 1, 4 and 16 only, so the routing claim is scored at rank 16 and rank 2 is untested for forced sources; Table 297b). Plan resampling and the literal top-five placement in the fitted coordinates on the grid task remain open items (Sections 7.10 and 7.11).
